name: Abel
bio: Abel is the second son of Adam and Eve, a keeper of sheep. He offered the firstlings of his flock and their fat to the LORD, and it was accepted; his brother Cain, jealous that his own offering was rejected, killed him — making Abel the first martyr recorded in Scripture (Genesis 4:2-8). The New Testament says that "by faith Abel offered unto God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, by which he obtained witness that he was righteous," and that though he is dead, through his faith "he yet speaketh" (Hebrews 11:4).
